en.title: Sum of Distinct Integer Quotients Less Than n
en.description:
Given n, collect every distinct x with 0≤x<n for which some positive integer k satisfies floor(n/k)=x, and find their sum. The original snapshot explicitly requires x<n, so the value n produced by k=1 must be excluded; 0 belongs to the set but does not affect the sum.

The standard I/O, examples and editorial were written independently by this site; ranges explicitly marked as this site's are not the source's original constraints.
en.input: One line containing an integer n, 1≤n≤10^10.
en.output: Output a single integer, the answer.
hints: Iterate over division blocks starting from denominator k=2. The current quotient q=n//k stays the same for denominators k..n//q; add q once and jump to the next block.
